notes.title: Game soundtrack is now available, and some bugfixes patch
notes.notes:
Sountrack:
Contains all music from the game

Bugfixes:
-Fixed a bug where the music wouldn't change according to the zone that the player was in. It used to default to the storage area (the first, blue zone) music. Now it should play the theme of the zone correctly.
-Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't load if you changed room while possessing two characters at the same time
-Fixed a bug where sometimes the soul wouldn't travel to the nearest body or reset the room
-Fixed some grammatical errors
-Fixed a bug where the controls "return" button couldn't be clicked with the mouse
-Fixed a bug where Satan would change to white color after damaging him for the first time
